query.text: 请陪我开车，听到我提出行程中的需求时，告诉我可以采取的措施。
query.text_en: Please accompany me while driving and tell me what I can do when I mention a travel-related need.

annotation.text_zh: 您提到油量可能不足，请先确认剩余油量，并用导航查找可到达的加油站。
annotation.text_en: You mentioned that fuel may be low. Please check the remaining fuel and use navigation to find a reachable gas station.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
